pr_body:
Fixes #5403

This PR adds an `exhaustiveFacetCount` field to the `/facet-search` API allowing the end-user to have a better facet count when having a distinct attribute set in the index settings.

 # Usage

`POST /index/:index_uid/facet-search`
**Body:**
```json
{
  "facetQuery": "blob",
  "facetName": "genres",
  "q": "",
  "exhaustiveFacetCount": true
}
```

# Prototype Docker images

```sh
$ docker pull getmeili/meilisearch:prototype-exhaustive-facet-search-00
```

issue_context.title: exhaustive facet search
issue_context.body:
Related product team resources: [PRD](https://www.notion.so/meilisearch/Exhaustive-facet-search-1ba4b06b651f803cb9fde5acba2423f1) (_internal only_)
Public usage: [Exhaustive-facet-search-usage](https://meilisearch.notion.site/Exhaustive-facet-search-usage-1ba4b06b651f802faf05e5bb5106fa47?pvs=4)

## Motivation

When using a paginated search with the facet distribution, the facet search is more exhaustive than the non-paginated one.
However, the facet-search has only one mode of exhaustivity when processing the counts, making them inconsistent with facet distribution counts coming from a paginated search

## Usage

`POST /index/:index_uid/facet-search`
**Body:**
```json
{
  "facetQuery": "blob",
  "facetName": "genres",
  "q": "",
  "exhaustiveFacetCount": true
}
```
